reviews.name: Bob B.
reviews.text: We have used SIS since moving here in 2018.  They have installed, serviced and updated our security, IT and home theater systems flawlessly. Whether we are home or on vacation they have taken care of our needs.  Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Laura B.
reviews.text: We were very fortunate to work with Ashley Shores at Sierra Integrated Systems. The quality of work in installing a surround sound system in our home was exceptional. Ashley and Shawn were extremely professional, knowledgeable, and informative and the other staff was amazing as well. They treated our home with a great deal of respect and we will be using this company again. We recommend SIS without reservation.

reviews.name: Kevin R.
reviews.text: We selected Sierra Integrated Systems to do a complete furnish and installation of lighting controls and automated window shades on a new custom home.  They are very good to deal with and really know their products.  Ryan Downing is a top notch project manager, and I would highly recommend them on any project.

reviews.name: Vince N.
reviews.text: Ryan Sei of Sierra Integrated System was excellent in providing insightful suggestions concerning the details of our smart home. The company is very responsive to customer needs and problem solving. Highly recommend them.

reviews.name: Claudia H.
reviews.text: Ryan and his team are the best.  They are very professional, extremely responsive, very easy to work with and great on follow up.   I would recommend their work to anyone, for A/V, lighting, security.   Excellence is achieved only with hard work, and they have.  Highly recommended.
